LESSON: WRITING 4.3.1 WRITING LETTER SOUNDS (F-J)

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP1
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 4
Topic 4.3: Writing 4.3.1 Writing letter sounds (f-j)
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 6

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 4.3.1 Writing letter sounds (f-j), part of Strand 4 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP1 General.

Key inquiry question: Where can we read letter sounds from? 2. What can we use to write letter sounds?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 4.3.1 Writing letter sounds (f-j) together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
● Responsibility: Determination as learner engages in the pre-writing activities such as coloring, modeling and tracing and

completes them.

● Integrity: Discipline as learner commits self to complete the assigned pre-writing activities.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
• Social cohesion as learner interacts with others in the pre-writing activities and works in harmony without conflicts.

• Personal hygiene awareness as learner washes hands after a modeling activity.

Link to other Learning Areas:
